sloka: त्वं मे बहुमतो राम गुणैर्बहुभिरुत्तमैः ।अतिथिः पूजनीयश्च मम नित्यं हृदि स्थितः ।। ७.७६.२६ ॥
transliteration: tvaṁ me bahumato rāma guṇairbahubhiruttamaiḥ ।atithiḥ pūjanīyaśca mama nityaṁ hṛdi sthitaḥ ।। 7.76.26 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, you are highly esteemed by me for your many excellent qualities, and you are a guest worthy of worship, always residing in my heart.
